Okay, it's August 13, 1980 and we're once again in the home of Eddie Sauter in West Nyack, New York and this is Bill Kirchner.

Just to tie up a statement that I ran out of tape for, I was stating that a friend of mine who was doing work orchestrating for Broadway shows, basically went through quite a bit of hassle when he was in the infant stages of doing arranging and orchestrating, just because the people were constantly changing the writing and making last minute changes and additions, and calling for them immediately.
You were going to make a statement?
